review.notes: Source-backed sheet replacements and progression. External prerequisites, optional replacements, companions, complex combat effects and extra named subchoices manual.

features.name: Sidestep
features.description:
At 2nd level, a dirty warrior learns how to evade his enemies when they react to his combat maneuvers. He gains a +1 dodge bonus to his AC against attacks of opportunity provoked by him while attempting a combat maneuver. This bonus increases by +1 for every four levels beyond 2nd level.

This ability replaces a warrior talent gained at 2nd level.
Sheet support: conditional combat bonuses, temporary forms, equipment, prerequisites and any extra subchoices are applied manually using existing sheet entries.

features.name: Maneuver Training
features.description:
At 5th level, a dirty warrior becomes a master of dirty tricks. He gains a +2 bonus on dirty trick combat maneuver checks and +2 to his CMD when he is the target of a dirty trick combat maneuver.

This ability replaces additional techs II.
Sheet support: conditional combat bonuses, temporary forms, equipment, prerequisites and any extra subchoices are applied manually using existing sheet entries.

features.name: Speedy Tricks
features.description:
At 9th level, a dirty warrior has perfected how to quickly perform dirty tricks. He can make a dirty trick combat maneuver as an attack instead of a [standard action](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/system-rules/pathfinder-basics/#standard).

This ability replaces additional techs IV.
Sheet support: conditional combat bonuses, temporary forms, equipment, prerequisites and any extra subchoices are applied manually using existing sheet entries.

features.name: Double Tricks
features.description:
At 13th level, when a dirty warrior performs a combat maneuver, he may apply two different conditions to his target instead of one. Each penalty condition requires a separate action to remove. At 17th level, he may apply three different conditions.

This ability replaces improved rush.
Sheet support: conditional combat bonuses, temporary forms, equipment, prerequisites and any extra subchoices are applied manually using existing sheet entries.
